sections.label: Singapore position of strength
sections.summary: Singapore is in a position of strength and can make substantial investments to meet economic and social needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: Today, Singapore is in a position of strength and able to make substantial investments to meet our economic and social needs.

sections.label: Slower growth expected
sections.summary: Global economic weakness and a more mature economy will mean slower growth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: Global economic weakness, coupled with a more mature economy, will mean slower growth.

sections.label: Building revenues for ageing population
sections.summary: Over the longer term, Government revenues should be built up to meet higher spending needs of an ageing population.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: Over the longer term, we should build up Government revenues to meet the higher spending needs of an ageing population.

sections.label: Silver Support Scheme income supplement
sections.summary: The Silver Support Scheme will provide an income supplement for the bottom 20%-30% of elderly Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: The Silver Support Scheme will provide an income supplement for the bottom 20%-30% of elderly Singaporeans.

sections.label: Investments in environment and transport
sections.summary: Singapore will enhance its living environment and support economic vibrancy through investments in greenery, housing, public transport, digital services and regional growth clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: We will enhance Singapore's living environment and support economic vibrancy through continued investments in greenery, housing and public transport.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: We are improving bus services and expanding our rail network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: While we do this, we will also make better use of our existing transportation infrastructure through the development of regional growth clusters that bring jobs closer to homes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: To improve the delivery of services to Singaporeans, we will provide better and more integrated services digitally, including through mobile platforms.

sections.label: Co-creating solutions with citizens
sections.summary: Singapore will increase opportunities for public collaboration and share more data so the private sector and public can create innovative applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: As part of our efforts to co-create solutions with citizens, we will increase opportunities for collaboration with the public through various platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
sentences.text: We will share more data so that the private sector and the public can help create innovative applications to meet economic and social needs.
